generate_vertical_tabert_training_data: run the script to generate vertical TableBert training data from a JSONL corpus for multiple epochs
sample_context_nearest: sample context sentences nearest to a table using the nearest strategy with a max length limit
sample_context_concatenate: sample context by concatenating before and after sentences and selecting random chunks of text
generate_for_epoch: generate pretraining instances for a single epoch and save row data and MLM data to an HDF5 file
TableDatabase_from_jsonl: load a JSONL corpus into a TableDatabase with a memory backend and specific table indices
